metadata.title: Worried about fallout from the AI debt binge? Do this. - MarketWatch

content.text:
12 hours ago
Worried about fallout from the AI debt binge? Do this.
Worries about fallout from the artificial intelligence spending spree have been hitting shares of CoreWeave, Oracle and other companies viewed as among the market's weaker hands.
The answer is to move up in credit quality, said Mike Khouw, chief strategist at YieldMax ETFs, in an interview Wednesday.
If a company has "massive negative cash flow" and a huge debt load, "you don't need to play in those," Khouw said. Instead, stick to high-quality names like Micron or Alphabet that have staying power if cracks in AI turn into a crash, and buy downside protection against the tech-heavy S&P 500, he said.
